title: 实义词：上下文
goal: 利用话题、复现及逻辑关系确定实义词，再用已给字母和词长核对。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 利用话题和复现的词补出实义词
利用对比、因果、举例关系补出实义词

body.p: 上下文能缩小缺词的意思范围。话题和复现的词说明讲的是什么东西。对比、因果、定义和举例说明词与词之间的关系。意思确定后，再核对已给字母、词长和词性。

body.box: The outer surface is rough, but the inner surface is smo___.

body.p: but 引出对比，这里填 rough 的反义词 smooth，放在 is 后面作形容词。smooth 共 6 个字母，已给 smo，补 oth。只看话题还可能想到别的材料性质，要靠 but 的对比来确定。

cards.title: 上下文线索
rows: 话题词
同一话题里的相关事物，说明缺词大致是哪类意思。
The orchestra tuned its instruments before the concert.
同义复现
后文用原词或同义词再说同一个东西。
The entrance was blocked. Nothing could pass through the opening.
对比
but、however、unlike 引出相反或不同的性质。
The first surface is rough, but the second is smooth. Unlike the heavy lid, this cover is light.
因果
because、so、as a result 连接原因与结果。
The cloth was wet because it had absorbed water. The pipe cracked, so water escaped. As a result, the floor became wet.
定义和举例
that is 后面是解释，such as 后面是同类的例子。
The material is opaque; that is, light cannot pass through it. Metals such as copper and iron conduct electricity.

cards.title: 字母与词长
rows: 已给字母
排除意思接近但开头不同的词。
rough 的反义词有 smooth 和 even，smo___ 只能是 smooth。
总长度
已给字母数加缺失字母数，就是全词的长度。
smooth：3 个已给字母 + 3 个缺失字母。
句法位置
在意思合适的词里，选词性对的那个。
The surface is smooth. The wheel moves smoothly.
整段关系
只看相邻的词定不下来时，回到前后句找依据。
The sample reflects light; it does not absorb it.

body.box: A curator places two bowls on a balance. Both bowls have the same volume, but one is made of a denser material. That bowl is hea____ than the other.

body.p: bowls、balance 和 denser material 说明话题是重量。体积相同时，密度大的那只更重，所以填 heavier。后面的 than 也要求比较级。
heavier 共 7 个字母，已给 hea，补 vier。heavy 长度不对，也不能和 than 连用。

cards.title: 练习一　话题与复现

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A music student is comparing wind instruments. Each instr{ument} produces sound when air inside it vibrates. The student uses a thin wooden reed; the re{ed} moves as air passes it. A microphone records the so{und}, and the recording is played again. The student compares a high note with a low no{te}. Each note has a particular pitch, and this pi{tch} can be measured. The air vibrates in a tube. A longer tu{be} produces a different pattern of vibr{ation}. The written comparison describes this pat{tern} in detail.
notes: instrument：首句的 wind instruments 是原词，Each 后面用单数。
reed：前面 a thin wooden reed 已点明对象。
sound：前句 produces sound 提供复现词。
note：与 high note 并列，重复 note。
pitch：this 回指前面 a particular pitch。
tube：前句 in a tube 给出同一部件。
vibration：前面的 vibrates 与 vibration 属同一词族。
pattern：this 回指刚提到的 pattern。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A class compares fabrics under a lamp. One sample is opa{que}; that is, no light passes through it. Another is trans{parent}, so objects behind it remain visible. The first cloth feels ro{ugh}, but the second feels smooth. Unlike the thick cloth, a th{in} sheet bends with little force. The class then adds water. One sample becomes w{et} because it absorbs the liquid. It grows hea{vier} as a result. After drying, it becomes lig{hter} again. Materials such as cotton and wool are fib{ers} used to make cloth.
notes: opaque：that is 后的 no light passes through it 定义 opaque。
transparent：objects behind it remain visible 说明材料透明。
rough：but 后的 smooth 与 rough 相对。
thin：Unlike 引出与 thick 相反的性质。
wet：because 后说它吸收了液体，所以变湿。
heavier：吸水后重量增加。grows 后面用比较级，表示和之前相比。
lighter：干了以后水分减少，重量减轻，与 heavier 相对。
fibers：cotton 和 wool 是纤维的例子，主语是复数，用 fibers。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A storage room contains drawers of different sizes. Each dra{wer} holds a set of tools. The tools are sorted into groups; each gr{oup} contains similar items. Wide drawers hold large tools, but nar{row} ones hold small parts. A label gives the name of each to{ol}. Some labels are difficult to read because the ink has become fa{int}. Fresh labels use dark ink and are therefore cl{ear}. The old labels are removed and repl{aced} with new ones. The replacement labels preserve the same na{mes} for the tools.
notes: drawer：前句的 drawers 是原词，Each 后面用单数。
group：前面 sorted into groups 提供复现词。
narrow：but 引出与 Wide 相反的宽度。
tool：前面的 tools 是原词，each 后面用单数。
faint：墨迹变淡是难读的原因。faint 与后句的 dark ink 相对。
clear：墨色深，所以清楚，与前句的 difficult to read 相对。
replaced：replace … with new ones 表示换成新的，后句的 replacement 是同一词族。
names：与 a label gives the name of each tool 对应，复数 names。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A display compares materials that transmit light with materials that block it. One panel is trans{parent}, so objects behind it remain visible. Another is opa{que}; that is, no light passes through it. A lamp sends li{ght} toward each panel. The la{mp} stays in the same position throughout the test. The class records the posi{tion} on a diagram. Unlike a rough sample, a smo{oth} panel has an even surface. Students inspect this sur{face} closely. They also compare a thick panel with a th{in} one and a rigid panel with a flex{ible} one. The flexible panel can be{nd}.

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A catalog team is removing duplicate entries from a collection list. Two entries describe the same obj{ect}, a wooden box. Because the object appears twice, one entry is redu{ndant}, that is, unnecessary. The team keeps one en{try} and removes the other. It then checks the collection li{st} for similar problems. Unlike the original list, the revised version is sho{rter}. Each surviving entry has a unique num{ber}. No two entries share a number. This makes each object easier to iden{tify}. A separate rec{ord} preserves changes in a digital file, so no information is lo{st}. The team stores this fi{le}.
